title.en: The riff that ate the band
title.zh: 把乐队吃掉的那句 riff

summary.en: One hook pays the mortgage and traps the setlist. Blessing. Prison. Sometimes both by the second chorus.
summary.zh: 一个 hook 付房贷，也锁死歌单。祝福。监狱。有时副歌第二遍两者都是。

body.en:
Satisfaction. Teen Spirit. You know the shape before the title finishes loading. That riff is a meal ticket and a cage: crowds wait for it like weather, and everything else becomes "the other songs."

Bands cope differently. Lean in and become a greatest-hits machine. Mock yourself. Or do the Radiohead move—mutate until the hit feels like a previous species. Either way, when a riff gets that big, the band doesn't own it anymore. Culture does.
body.zh:
Satisfaction。Teen Spirit。歌名还没加载完，你已经知道形状。那句 riff 是饭票也是笼子：人群像等天气一样等它，其它都成了「剩下的歌」。

乐队的活法不同。迎上去，变成精选辑机器。自嘲。或者学 Radiohead——变种到那首热歌听起来像上一物种。不管怎样，riff 大到那个份上，乐队不再拥有它。文化拥有它。

note.en: The art of fleeing your own chorus.
